apps.name: Restring Helper
apps.versionDescription:
# Restring Helper — Full Changelog

---

## Dashboard
- **5-second SMS undo** — When an order is marked as done, the SMS is held for 5 seconds. An undo toast appears during this window. If tapped, the order is unmarked and no SMS is sent.
- **Empty state background fix** — Both empty states (all caught up / filter no match) now use the correct grouped background colour instead of a white flash.
- **Removed auto-refresh** — The dashboard no longer polls every 30 seconds when idle. Orders load once on open, and refresh after actions or pull-to-refresh.
- **Refresh control fix** — Fixed a runtime warning ("attempting to change the refresh control while not idle") caused by concurrent refresh calls.

---

## New Order
- **Card / Cash picker** — When "Customer has paid" is toggled on, a segmented **Card / Cash** picker appears. The payment method is stored and passed to Shopify when the order is created.
- **Pickup date/time hint** — A small resolved date (e.g. "Pickup: Friday, 29 Aug at 2:00 PM") is shown below the time pickers so you can confirm the actual date before saving.
- **"Same as Mains" button fix** — Moved to its own row below the crosses tension picker so it no longer overlaps or sits awkwardly.
- **Customer autocomplete performance fix** — Previously loading all customers caused crashes or slow-downs with a large database. Now uses server-side prefix search: debounced 300 ms, minimum 2 characters, returns max 10 results.

---

## Shopify Auto-Order
- **Automatic order creation on drop-off payment (Scenario A)** — When a new order is created with "Customer has paid" toggled on, a Shopify order is automatically created in the background.
  - Line item is always `"Restring"` regardless of string used.
  - Price is parsed from the `£XX` amount in the order.
  - Cash → `Cash` gateway. Card → `Card - String Sports` gateway.
  - No order note is added.
- **Scenario B (pay at pickup)** — No auto-creation. Handled through Shopify POS as normal.
- **Duplicate guard** — A `shopify_order_id` column prevents the same order being created twice.

---

## Analytics
- **Timeframe picker** — Added **Today / 7D / 30D / All Time** segmented control at the top of the Analytics screen. Each selection re-fetches data from the backend for that period.
- **Removed refresh button** — The blue manual refresh toolbar button has been removed. Pull-to-refresh still works.

---

## Customers
- **Removed count from nav title** — The customer count no longer appears in the navigation bar.
- **Blank names filtered** — Customers with empty names are hidden from the list.
- **Duplicate merging** — Customers with the same phone number are deduplicated client-side (the originals in Shopify/DB are untouched).

---

## Zebra Printer Label
- **Note star indicator** — If an order has a note, a small `*` is printed in the top-right corner of the ZPL label as a visual reminder to check the note.

---

## Settings
- **Printer status UI fix** — The printer status indicator now uses a coloured dot + text style, matching the System Status rows, instead of a system icon.
- **Theme fix** — Changing theme (System / Light / Dark) inside Settings now applies immediately to the Settings sheet itself, not just the background.
- **Vonage SMS credit** — The Vonage SMS API row in System Status now shows your remaining credit as small caption text below the label (e.g. `£10.22 credit`). Updates when you tap Refresh.
- **Reset Analytics History** — A red **Reset Analytics History** button at the bottom of Settings permanently deletes all completed order history (pending orders are unaffected). Requires confirmation via an alert before anything is deleted.

---

## Sidebar & Layout
- **Sidebar white background** — The sidebar now has a white/system background so it's visually distinct from the main content area, and the settings icon at the bottom blends in more naturally.

---

## App-Wide
- **All orientations supported** — The app now supports portrait, landscape left, landscape right, and upside-down portrait on all devices.
- **iPad keyboard shortcuts removed** — ⌘S / ⌘P shortcuts on the Save and Save & Print buttons have been removed.
- **Xcode recommended settings applied** — `ENABLE_USER_SCRIPT_SANDBOXING`, `ASSETCATALOG_COMPILER_GENERATE_SWIFT_ASSET_SYMBOL_EXTENSIONS`, and `SWIFT_EMIT_LOC_STRINGS` added to the project, clearing the "Update to recommended settings" warning.
- **Swift concurrency warnings fixed** — `ZebraPrinterService` marked as `@unchecked Sendable` to clear Sendable capture warnings introduced by the stricter build settings.
apps.localizedDescription: An application to help with stringing sports racquets and printing labels with Zebra printers.
